name: Summit AZ - Homepage Copy Draft 2026-09-04
body:
> Plan · Summit Az · 2026-09-04

# Summary
Homepage copy written for Scott's rebuild of the Arizona site, Sep 4, 2026. Two versions: `Summit-AZ-Homepage-Copy-Draft-2026-09-04.docx` (v1) and `Summit-AZ-Homepage-Copy-Draft-v2-2026-09-04.docx` (v2, keyword-optimized). Design and section order unchanged; phone left as [PHONE] because of the GHL number pool. A `~$` lock file for v1 also sits in the folder (ignore).

# What v2 adds
- Keyword research from Search Atlas plus the site's own GSC: the homepage clicked only on brand terms but got impressions at positions 30 to 55 for "plumbing repair mesa az", "plumbing companies mesa az" and "best plumber in mesa az".
- Hero targets "plumber mesa az" (2,400), "plumbing company mesa az" (320) and others; each service section lists its target terms (for example "emergency plumber mesa az" 140, "sewer repair phoenix az" 70).
- Sections for trenchless sewer repair (signature), emergency plumber, water softeners and filtration, sewer inspection and the other services.

# Caution
- This draft predates the business rules set Sep 5 to 25. It contains wording now prohibited: "24/7" and "24-hour emergency plumber line", "bonded", "Same-Day Service" as a flat claim, "family-owned" and "locally-owned", and "leading cause" style claims. Do not reuse it without checking against [Summit AZ - Decisions and Rules](lib:brain-summit-az-decisions-and-rules).
- The homepage has been locked since Sep 7 (Scott); later homepage work is in [Summit AZ - Homepage GBP Alignment 2026-10-21](lib:brain-summit-az-homepage-gbp-alignment-2026-10-21).
